title: Source-of-funds documentation
definition: A request for documentation establishing the origin of funds that cannot be explained by the subject's declared profile. It is the standard request where a measured pattern is present and the corroborating records that would distinguish the readings are absent.
evidence_to_cite: the pattern that prompted the request, cited by source id and pointer
the absence of the requested records, recorded as a gap
benign_explanations: The records exist and the customer supplies them promptly; the request is a routine part of establishing the declared profile.

sources.citation: FinCrime evidence request catalogue, entry REQ-SOF-001.
